reports.title: CENCORA REPORTS FISCAL 2026 FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL YEAR END RESULTS

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2027 Expectations
section: The Company does not provide forward-looking expectations on a GAAP basis as certain financial information, the probable significance of which cannot be determined, is not available and cannot be reasonably estimated. Please refer to the Supplemental Information Regarding Non-GAAP Financial Measures following the tables for additional information.
Fiscal Year 2027 Expectations on an Adjusted (non-GAAP) Basis

2027 Expectations | Fiscal 2026 Actuals
Revenue | 3% to 5% growth | $337.4B
Pharmaceutical Distribution and Services(1) | 4% to 6% growth | $284.5B
Specialty Pharmaceutical and Provider Services(1) | 9% to 14% growth | $45.4B
Other(2) | ~$3.5B | $8.7B
Adjusted operating income | 4% to 6% growth | $4.8B
Pharmaceutical Distribution and Services(1) | 2% to 4% growth | $2.7B
Specialty Pharmaceutical and Provider Services(1) | 18% to 21% growth | $1.7B
Other(2) | ~$200M | $393M
Adjusted diluted earnings per share | $19.40 to $19.75 | $17.97
Net interest expense | $490M to $510M | $490M
Adjusted effective tax rate | ~20% | 19.5%
Diluted weighted average shares outstanding | ~190M | 194.1M
Adjusted free cash flow | ~$3.5B | $3.8B
(1) For further detail on fiscal 2026 revised reportable segment information, please reference Exhibit 99.1 to the Company’s Form 8-K to be furnished November 4, 2026.

(2) The Company’s fiscal year 2027 expectations contemplate the sale of the equity interest in Profarma closing in the first fiscal quarter and assume a March 31, 2027 closing of the MWI Animal Health merger with Covetrus.

desk.period: Q4 fiscal 2026 and full year (quarter to 30 Sep 2026)
desk.headline: Q4 revenue up 5.5% to $88.4bn, adjusted EPS $4.66 beat; FY2027 EPS guide of $19.40–19.75 below Street growth hopes
results: Quarterly revenue rose 5.5% to $88.4bn on higher specialty drug and GLP-1 volumes, partly offset by lower sales to its large mail-order customer.
Adjusted operating income jumped 22% to $1.2bn, mainly thanks to the OneOncology purchase in February; adjusted EPS rose 21% to $4.66.
For the full year, revenue grew 5% to $337.4bn and adjusted EPS 12% to $17.97; GAAP EPS of $17.95 includes a $1.1bn one-off gain on OneOncology.
The quarterly dividend goes up 10% to $0.66; $1.0bn of shares were bought back during the year.
Deals: agreement to buy American Oncology Network, Profarma stake sale due to close in Q1 FY27, and MWI Animal Health set to merge with Covetrus.

guidance.summary: First outlook for fiscal 2027 (year to Sep 2027): adjusted EPS of $19.40–19.75, up 8–10%, below the roughly 14% growth analysts had pencilled in, mainly because of planned business sales. Long-term targets of 10–14% EPS growth were reaffirmed.

points: Planned sales (Profarma, MWI Animal Health) cut about $0.35 from FY27 EPS; without them growth would be 10–12%.
Growth is being steered to specialty: the new specialty and provider services segment is guided to 18–21% profit growth, helped by oncology and retina practices.
Mainstream drug distribution profit is guided up only 2–4%, held back by a customer volume shift and currency.
Management plans about $1.25bn of buybacks in FY27 alongside the 10% dividend increase.
GLP-1 weight-loss drugs keep lifting revenue but weigh on gross margin, which slipped from Q3.

watch: First results under the new segment structure in Q1 FY27 (Feb 2027).
Closing of the Profarma sale, the MWI–Covetrus merger and the American Oncology Network deal.
Whether specialty growth can offset slower drug-distribution profit.
